subject: signalgrid-mcp#14 complete: fixes + live macOS CI gate for the bug class
body: PR #14 now closes the loop end to end. Beyond the 3 modern-macOS collector fixes (XProtect/updates/screen-lock, real-hardware-verified): added tests/test_live_collectors.py that read this machine's REAL state and a test-macos CI job (runs-on macos-latest) — signalgrid-mcp CI was ubuntu-only, which is exactly why these shipped. Proven RED on unfixed main / GREEN on the branch. Hardened the screen-lock live test to skip cleanly on a headless runner (no GUI session) so the macOS job won't flake. 110 tests. This is the gate the sibling never had. Also confirmed sound (no change): review-hub macos-posture-proof.ts already pins the unavailable/%Su fail-open cases (72 assertions), and readableString rejects error strings — the integration with my fix is fail-safe.
